title: Docs: Add FAQ entry for CI test failures with browser mode for addon-vitest
body:
Relates https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/issues/33347

CI environments running large numbers of Vitest browser-mode stories in parallel can exhaust resources, causing failures like `"Failed to fetch dynamically imported module"` and `"Cannot connect to the iframe"` — errors that don't reproduce locally.

Adds a new FAQ entry to the addon-vitest docs covering:

- **Root cause**: parallel test execution overwhelming CI runner resources
- **Fix 1 — disable isolation**: reduces per-file environment overhead via `isolate: false`
- **Fix 2 — sharding**: splits the test suite across multiple CI jobs using `--shard=N/M`

```ts
// vitest.config.ts — disable isolation
export default defineConfig({
  test: {
    isolate: false,
  },
});
```

```bash
# CI — shard across jobs
vitest run --shard=1/3
vitest run --shard=2/3
vitest run --shard=3/3
```

    if: github.event.deployment_status.state == 'success' && contains(github.event.deployment_status.environment_url, 'storybook')
    steps:

          node-version-file: '.node-version'
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      - name: Get PR number
        uses: jwalton/gh-find-current-pr@master
        id: findPr
        with:
          state: open
      - name: Run Storybook tests
        run: pnpm test:sb
        env:
          SB_URL: '${{ github.event.deployment_status.environment_url }}'
      - name: Upload Accessibility Report
        id: artifact-upload-step
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: accessibility-report
          path: ./config/storybook/artifacts/accessibilityReport.html
          overwrite: 'true'
      - name: Accessibility Report Preview
        if: success() && steps.findPr.outputs.number
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@v3
        with:
          pr-number: ${{ steps.findPr.outputs.number }}
          message: |
            Accessibility tests executed. Download the report [here](${{ steps.artifact-upload-step.outputs.artifact-url }}).

```
